articles.title: GOKMUL:ONE Goes Live on CJ ONSTYLE TV Home Shopping (March 20)
articles.excerpt: Our Grain TokTok Premium Care Edition 110g airs on CJ ONSTYLE TV home shopping on March 20 — a broadcast-only special set in three grain blends.
body: Premium grain care-food brand GOKMUL:ONE will hold a live broadcast on CJ ONSTYLE TV home shopping on March 20, from 2:35 to 3:30 PM (KST), featuring the Grain TokTok Premium Care Edition 110g. The product was previously introduced on CJ ONSTYLE's flagship program “The Lee Seung-yeon Show,” where it drew strong consumer interest.

As the “slow-aging” wellness trend takes center stage, interest in healthy eating continues to grow — and so does demand for whole grains. Minimally processed whole-grain foods that preserve nutrition are gaining attention as a new wellness food culture, particularly among mature consumers.
GOKMUL:ONE is a premium grain brand that proposes healthy grain-eating habits through whole-grain convenience foods. Its flagship product, born from this philosophy, is Meal Essence Grain TokTok.

For this broadcast, GOKMUL:ONE presents its flagship Grain TokTok in a special TV-shopping set and price. It unveils the 110g Premium Care Edition — an upgrade of the 40g product previously sold online and in department stores. Available in three grain blends — Chickpea & Oat, Black Soybean & Lentil, and Khorasan & Farro — the edition offers a larger volume and enhanced nutritional design tailored to TV-shopping customers, prepared as a set available only during the broadcast.

Grain TokTok is developed with GOKMUL:ONE's own Grain-Care technology: a soaking process tuned to each grain's characteristics, combined with high-temperature, high-pressure cooking that preserves nutrition while gently softening the texture. With no soaking or cooking required — simply open and eat — it delivers a moist, tender bite and has earned a high repurchase rate among consumers.

GOKMUL:ONE is currently available at premium food retailers including Shinsegae Department Store (Main and Gangnam branches) and House of Shinsegae. Following its department-store presence, the CJ ONSTYLE broadcast marks another step in expanding the brand's footprint in the premium grain convenience-food market.

“As interest in healthy grain-eating grows, demand for products that make whole grains easy to enjoy keeps rising,” a GOKMUL:ONE representative said. “Through this CJ ONSTYLE broadcast, we hope to propose a new food culture where anyone can enjoy a healthy grain meal, simply, even in a busy daily life.”

articles.title: GOKMUL:ONE Enters House of Shinsegae Cheongdam “Twelve”
articles.excerpt: GOKMUL:ONE joins “Twelve,” the highly curated premium food hall at House of Shinsegae Cheongdam.
body: Premium grain care-food brand GOKMUL:ONE has entered “Twelve,” the food hall at House of Shinsegae Cheongdam in Cheongdam-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul.

As interest in healthy eating and slow-aging grows, minimally processed whole-grain foods are drawing attention as a new wellness food culture, and demand for health-oriented products continues to expand — especially within premium food halls.

Twelve is a basement-level food hall created by fully renovating the former SSG Food Market Cheongdam. It curates around 6,000 products according to twelve criteria such as origin, seasonality, and carbon footprint. Known for its demanding entry standards, GOKMUL:ONE's inclusion here further strengthens the brand's premium image.

Through this opening, GOKMUL:ONE presents two of its flagship Grain TokTok varieties — Chickpea & Oat and Black Soybean & Lentil. These are ready-to-eat grain foods that require no soaking or cooking, designed so anyone can enjoy a healthy grain meal even in a busy daily life.

Grain TokTok is developed with GOKMUL:ONE's own Grain-Care technology, applying a soaking process tuned to each grain and high-temperature, high-pressure cooking to preserve nutrients while softening texture — making whole grains easier and more comfortable to enjoy.

Beyond Twelve, GOKMUL:ONE has recently opened at Shinsegae Department Store's Main and Gangnam branches, and will meet customers on home shopping via a CJ ONSTYLE TV broadcast later this month — broadening its presence across online, department stores, premium food halls, and TV shopping.

“Twelve is a space to meet discerning consumers directly — an important channel for conveying GOKMUL:ONE's brand philosophy and product value,” a representative from GOKMUL:ONE's strategic planning team said. “We will continue to contribute to consumers' healthy diets through diverse touchpoints.”

articles.title: GOKMUL:ONE Opens at Shinsegae Department Store Main Branch (Myeongdong)
articles.excerpt: GOKMUL:ONE arrives at Shinsegae Department Store's Main Branch, bringing two Grain TokTok blends to a flagship offline destination.
body: Premium grain care-food brand GOKMUL:ONE has opened at the Main Branch of Shinsegae Department Store.

With the rise of the “slow-aging” trend, interest in healthy eating is growing and so is demand for whole grains. Minimally processed whole-grain foods that preserve nutrition are gaining attention as a new wellness food culture, and the market continues to expand.
GOKMUL:ONE is a premium grain brand proposing healthy grain-eating habits through whole-grain convenience foods, with its flagship Meal Essence Grain TokTok.

At the Shinsegae Main Branch, shoppers can find two varieties of Grain TokTok in person. This is meaningful in that consumers who previously encountered the brand mainly online can now see and purchase the products in an offline space.

Grain TokTok is made with GOKMUL:ONE's own Grain-Care technology — a soaking process tuned to each grain and high-temperature, high-pressure cooking that preserves nutrition while softening texture. It is ready to eat, with no soaking or cooking required.

Online, GOKMUL:ONE offers a broad range including Kamut & Farro and Farro & Fava Bean, while offline it focuses on flagship products to deliver a brand experience — a channel-specific strategy that builds synergy and widens consumer touchpoints.

“Opening at the Shinsegae Main Branch is an opportunity to introduce the healthy lifestyle and grain food culture we pursue to more consumers,” a GOKMUL:ONE representative said. “We will continue to expand consumer touchpoints across diverse channels as a brand that proposes healthy grain-eating habits.”
